newsitem.title: USA: USDA says Missouri, Tenn. free of pink bollworm.
newsitem.headline: USDA says Missouri, Tenn. free of pink bollworm.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Department said Friday it removed Missouri and Tennessee from the list of states quarantined because of pink bollworm.
In a notice published in the Federal Register, USDA said it removed Clay, Crittenden and Mississippi counties in Arkansas from its quarantine list.
Field surveys showed the pink bollworm no longer exists in these areas, the agency's Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service said.
The pink bollworm is one of the world's most destructive pests of cotton, and exists throughout most of the cotton-producing states west of the Missippi River.
